urls.title: Page or PDF URLs
urls.description: Links to the web pages or PDFs to read, one per line (up to 50). Each must be a public http or https URL (ports 80 and 443) that serves a web page or a PDF of at most 10 MB, on a site whose robots.txt allows automated fetching. Every page that yields at least one of your fields is one result. A link that cannot be fetched, or a page that states none of your fields, returns nothing and is not charged.

schema.title: Fields to extract
schema.description: A JSON object that names each field you want and its type: string, number, boolean, date or string[] (a list of text). 1 to 20 fields, the same for every URL. A value the page does not state comes back as null, never as a guess.
